title: Draykop the Amazon
description: Draykop the Amazon — The Townstons wiki
html: Draykop the Amazon appeared in Build 130 with the implementation of the Bling Gnome. She offers a link to the well known online bookseller to buy the retail box. She is also a merchant, and sells very high quality Items, some yellows, mostly purples and occasionally a rainbow. They are divided into LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH categories. Prices are high but not outrageous. She also buys loot, and as of Build 138 it appears that she offers approximately 10% more for purple and rainbow loot than the other merchants.
